in_marathi.name: Kalesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Time, Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kalesh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Kala, which means 'time' or 'god of time', and Ish, which means 'god'. Thus, Kalesh means 'God of Time' or 'God of Fortune'. In Hindu mythology, Kalesh is worshipped as the god of time, change, and fate. He is also believed to be the preserver of the universe.
